******************************************************************
*STATA syntax code for the computation of index*
*values with the Chinese value set (TTO)*
*Reference: Luo N, Liu G, Li M, Guan H, Jin X, Rand-Hendriksen K. Estimating an EQ-5D-5L Value Set for China. Value Health. 2017 Apr;20(4):662-669.
*Source: https://euroqol.org/information-and-support/resources/value-sets/
******************************************************************;

gen disut_mo = .
replace disut_mo = 0 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 1
replace disut_mo = 0.066 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 2
replace disut_mo = 0.158 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 3
replace disut_mo = 0.287 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 4
replace disut_mo = 0.345 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 5

gen disut_sc = .
replace disut_sc = 0 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 1
replace disut_sc = 0.048 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 2
replace disut_sc = 0.116 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 3
replace disut_sc = 0.210 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 4
replace disut_sc = 0.253 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 5

gen disut_ua = .
replace disut_ua = 0 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 1
replace disut_ua = 0.045 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 2
replace disut_ua = 0.107 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 3
replace disut_ua = 0.194 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 4
replace disut_ua = 0.233 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 5

gen disut_pd = .
replace disut_pd = 0 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 1
replace disut_pd = 0.058 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 2
replace disut_pd = 0.138 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 3
replace disut_pd = 0.252 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 4
replace disut_pd = 0.302 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 5

gen disut_ad = .
replace disut_ad = 0 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 1
replace disut_ad = 0.049 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 2
replace disut_ad = 0.118 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 3
replace disut_ad = 0.215 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 4
replace disut_ad = 0.258 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 5

gen disut_total = disut_mo + disut_sc + disut_ua + disut_pd + disut_ad 

gen EQ_index = . 
replace EQ_index = 1 - disut_total
replace EQ_index = round(EQ_index, .001)
